mapper.select: SELECT k.id, k.knowledge_name AS knowledgeName, k.remark, k.embedding_model_id AS embeddingModelId, m.model_name AS embeddingModelName, k.vector_db_id AS vectorDbId, v.db_name AS vectorDbName, k.status FROM bedrock_ai_knowledge k LEFT JOIN bedrock_ai_model m ON k.embedding_model_id = m.id AND m.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN bedrock_ai_vector_db v ON k.vector_db_id = v.id AND v.is_deleted = 0 WHERE k.id = #{id} AND k.is_deleted = 0

SELECT k.id, k.knowledge_name AS knowledgeName, k.remark, k.embedding_model_id AS embeddingModelId, m.model_name AS embeddingModelName, k.vector_db_id AS vectorDbId, v.db_name AS vectorDbName, k.status, k.create_time AS createTime FROM bedrock_ai_knowledge k LEFT JOIN bedrock_ai_model m ON k.embedding_model_id = m.id AND m.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN bedrock_ai_vector_db v ON k.vector_db_id = v.id AND v.is_deleted = 0 WHERE k.is_deleted = 0
AND k.knowledge_name LIKE concat('%', #{param.knowledgeName}, '%')
AND k.status = #{param.status}
ORDER BY k.create_time DESC
